d: X-Series Amplifier, 750 The AMP-X750 is a high performance, compact, energy efficient, professional grade amplifier. Supporting Lo-Z and Hi-Z operation, this multichannel amplifier is suitable for both residential and commercial configurations.

specs.label: Output Power per Channel
specs.value: 250 W (4 or 8 Ω), 500 W (8 Ω only), 500 W (70V/100V); NOTE: Total simultaneous output power across all channels will not exceed 750 W

specs.label: Frequency Response
specs.value: 20 Hz to 20 kHz ±0.5 dB at 1 W

specs.label: THD+N
specs.value: <0.1% at 1 kHz @ -3 dB full rated output power

specs.label: Input Sensitivity
specs.value: 1.23 Vrms, +4 dBu balanced; 0.316 Vrms, -10 dBV unbalanced

specs.label: Protection
specs.value: Overcurrent, under voltage, over temperature, DC offset, extreme high frequency

specs.label: Go to Sleep Time
specs.value: 25 minutes with no signal present (when set to POWER SAVER)
